During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], the '''"Blue Team"''' of the [[Rift Alliance]] consisting of [[Tai Cordan]]'s [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] moved inside [[Guardian Hold Four]]'s outer defensive perimeter and disabled the generators powering the main door after [[the Barsen'thor]] disabled enemy sensors in the vicinity.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|As Above, So Below|Corellia}}</ref>
